data.title: Fiction Shigi Yama
data.synopsis:
A story about a dharmapala, a Buddhist deity that often takes on the form of a child, who helps a monk on various adventures. From healing a sick emperor to returning a stolen rice bowl, this charming story is rooted in the mythology of Chougosonshi-ji temple on Mt. Shigi in Nara, Japan.

(Source: Collaborative Cataloging Japan)
